scope: Same Mac, Vite development server, headless Chrome; synchronous draw CPU excludes GPU completion and React; two retained windows per variant
collection: Ticks collected every 40 draws to avoid 240-sample ring overflow; diagnostic snapshot cost is outside frameWorkMs but can affect rAF; no profiler, screenshot or pixel readback during measured windows
